_comment: #ddev-generated — the tryout Composer overlay. It lives in Build/ and is selected via COMPOSER=composer.tryout.json in .ddev/config.tryout.yaml. The project root is the TYPO3 Core clone itself, so the paths below reach UP out of Build/. Your own composer.json is merged in and never rewritten; `ddev tryout composer` regenerates the require block from the sysexts in the Core checkout.
description: TYPO3 development environment — Core contribution & custom extensions
